verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਘ ਬਰਖਾ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਬਰਖੈ ਸਮਾਨ  ਊਚੋ ਤਜ ਨੀਚੈ ਥਲ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise megh barakhaa sarabatr barakhai samaan  uoocho taj neechai thal gavan kai jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as rain falls alike all over, and the water falling on higher ground flow down to lower ground automatically.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਪਰਬ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਚਲ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੇਤ ਦੇਤ ਦਾਨ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: teerath parab jaise jaat hai jagat chal jaatraa het dhet dhaan at bigasaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as on festivals people go to places of pilgrimage and feels happy making charities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੋਭਤ ਹੈ ਬੈਠਿਓ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਪੈ  ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਤੇ ਦਰਬ ਆਵੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise nirap sobhat hai baiThio si(n)ghaasan pai  chahoo(n) or te dharab aavai dhin raat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a king sits on throne and earns admirations, he receives gifts and offerings from all sides both during day and night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਚਲ ਆਵਤ ਜੁਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੨੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise nihakaam dhaam saadh hai sa(n)saar bikhai asan basan chal aavat jugaat hai ||629||

en.bdb: Similarly, the house of God-like True Guru is without desires. Like the rain water, charity at places of pilgrimage and the king, food items, clothes and money of Daswandh keep pouring in the house of the True Guru.
